# Workshop App — Copilot Instructions

## Project
A web application scaffold for the Agentic SDLC Workshop.
The application domain and feature are defined in Issue #1 and the BRD.
Read those files to understand what is being built before writing any code.

## Tech Stack
- Backend:  Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4.x + Maven
- Frontend: Angular 19 + TypeScript
- Database: SQLite via Spring Data JPA / Hibernate (auto DDL)
- Auth:     Spring Security + JWT (pre-built — do not rebuild)
- Testing:  JUnit 5 + REST Assured (unit/integration) + Playwright (E2E)

## What Is Pre-built — Never Rebuild These
- Login and Register pages
- Spring Security config   → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/config/SecurityConfig.java
- JWT authentication filter → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/config/JwtAuthenticationFilter.java
- JWT utility              → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/config/JwtUtil.java
- Auth controller          → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/controller/AuthController.java
- Auth service             → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/service/AuthService.java
- User entity              → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/model/User.java
- User repository          → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/repository/UserRepository.java
- Data seeder (test user)  → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/seed/DataSeeder.java
- Spring Boot entry        → src/backend/src/main/java/com/workshop/app/Application.java
- Angular app entry        → src/frontend/src/app/app.component.ts
- Angular routing + guard  → src/frontend/src/app/app.routes.ts
- Auth guard               → src/frontend/src/app/guards/auth.guard.ts
- Auth service             → src/frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts
- Navbar shell             → src/frontend/src/app/components/navbar/
- Login page               → src/frontend/src/app/pages/login/
- Register page            → src/frontend/src/app/pages/register/

## What Is Workshop Work — Agents Build This
- All domain JPA entities (added to model/ package by design-agent / Coding Agent)
- All domain JPA repositories (added to repository/ package)
- All API controllers and services
- All Angular feature components and pages
- All seed data beyond the test user (added to DataSeeder.java)
- All JUnit 5 + REST Assured tests
- All Playwright E2E tests
- HomePage content — the placeholder ("Features coming soon") is replaced
  by the [FRONTEND] Issue's primary feature component

## Coding Standards
- No raw `Object` type — use proper generics and DTOs
- Java enums mandatory for categorical fields — never use String
- Use `@Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)` on all enum fields
- All domain entities are plain POJOs with JPA annotations — no base class
- All API errors return `{ "error": "string" }` via an ErrorResponse record
- All protected endpoints use existing Spring Security JWT filter — do not create new auth
- Standard Java patterns — no CompletableFuture abuse
- Angular components use standalone style
- All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes
- No `any` in TypeScript

## File Structure
```
src/
├── backend/
│   ├── pom.xml
│   └── src/
│       ├── main/
│       │   ├── java/com/workshop/app/
│       │   │   ├── Application.java
│       │   │   ├── config/          (SecurityConfig, JwtAuthenticationFilter, JwtUtil)
│       │   │   ├── model/           (User.java + domain entities added by agents)
│       │   │   ├── repository/      (UserRepository + domain repos)
│       │   │   ├── service/         (AuthService + domain services)
│       │   │   ├── controller/      (AuthController + domain controllers)
│       │   │   ├── dto/             (request/response DTOs)
│       │   │   └── seed/            (DataSeeder.java)
│       │   └── resources/
│       │       └── application.properties
│       └── test/java/com/workshop/app/   (JUnit tests go here)
└── frontend/
    ├── angular.json
    ├── package.json
    └── src/app/
        ├── app.component.ts
        ├── app.routes.ts
        ├── guards/
        ├── services/
        ├── pages/
        └── components/

docs/
├── requirements/
│   └── BRD.md              ← generated by brd-agent
└── design/
    └── design-doc.md       ← generated by design-agent

issues/                     ← generated by user-story-agent
e2e/                        ← generated by playwright-agent
```

## Never
- Rebuild auth (Spring Security config, JWT filter, AuthController, AuthService)
- Use raw `Object` type in Java — use generics and DTOs
- Use `String` for categorical fields — use Java enums with `@Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)`
- Use `any` in TypeScript
- Skip `data-testid` on interactive elements
- Touch pre-built files unless the Issue explicitly requires it
